changes.route_dependency: The expert-upload callback remains on the consumed selected-ID path. The remap and MUL_MAT_ID graph therefore cannot execute before the synchronous miss upload and LUT update.
changes.lru_epoch: Each ensure_resident call assigns one use epoch to all selected experts, preventing rank order inside one token from biasing eviction.
changes.cache_observability: Per-layer steps, hits, misses, hit rate, upload bytes, upload batches, resident slots, and capacity are logged on the first step and every 32 decode steps.
changes.launcher_fit: The launcher now disables automatic fit when a Neural Island is enabled so side-loaded island weights and cache slots are included in the known placement contract.
